query: How should we choose K (precision@K) and decision thresholds to minimize reviewer time per corrected error; what simulation design will produce reviewer labor vs precision curves?

response.query: How should we choose K (precision@K) and decision thresholds to minimize reviewer time per corrected error; what simulation design will produce reviewer labor vs precision curves?
response.answer: Choose K based on desired precision and reviewer efficiency; simulate with varying K values to plot labor vs. precision curves. Optimal K minimizes errors while balancing reviewer time.

results.title: A Novel Approach to Mapping the Spatial Distribution of Fruit Trees ...
results.content: We propose a novel decision tree approach to map the spatial distribution of fruit trees at a 10 m spatial resolution based on the growth stage features.
